rules.name: SQL Injection Attack Detected
rules.description: Detects SQL injection patterns in HTTP requests including UNION SELECT, OR 1=1, and comment-based injection
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, AzureDiagnostics | where Message contains "wstg" or Message contains "input-validation" | summarize count(), make_set(SourceIP) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), ActivityDisplayName | where count_ > 3
